findings.evidence: Prod bundle (5902/3902), iPhone 13 profile, learner with a complete Hematology vault. Type any wrong 3-digit code in the Code Vault input, then hold Enter (12 keydown repeats at 40 ms, i.e. about 0.5 s of key repeat). Network: 5 x 422 then 7 x 429. The card shows 'Too many incorrect codes. Try again in 10 minutes.' and the CORRECT code is then refused with the same message (API check: correct code while locked = 429). The form has no e.repeat guard, so one slightly long Enter press burns all 5 tries. Recovery exists only by waiting 10 minutes or Reset guest session (reproduced: after /demo/reset + replay the correct code returns 200), which also wipes progress; the message does not say so. Script: scratchpad/r39B/vaultheld.mjs, lockrec.mjs.
findings.fix_hint: Ignore event.repeat on the vault form (onKeyDown Enter with repeat), or disable Unlock until the code differs from the last rejected one; optionally count only distinct codes server-side.

findings.evidence: Prod bundle desktop. bio-01 step 1: select a wrong option, focus Submit answer, hold Enter (25 repeats at 30 ms). 26 POSTs: 25 wrong answers recorded; Case status reads Wrong answers 25, XP penalty so far -150 (capped); a 160-repeat hold recorded 85 wrong answers. Each repeat re-submits the same wrong answer because focus returns to Submit after every reply. The wrong-answer count is permanent history (accuracy). Extends known B-004 (same wrong answer charged each time) with the one-keypress amplification. Also: after that, one paid hint made 'XP penalty so far' go from -150 to -130 (the hint removes the +20 No-hint bonus so the cap budget shrinks), i.e. paying for a hint lowered the displayed penalty.
findings.fix_hint: Skip submit when event.repeat or when the answer is identical to the last rejected one; compute 'XP penalty so far' including forfeited bonuses.

findings.evidence: Mission screen says 'Each hint costs 15 XP.' (also Case status 'XP penalty so far'), but the first hint on a mission also forfeits the No-hint bonus (+20 standard, +60 Master). Reproduced on prod: hem-01 with 1 hint, 0 wrong = 145 of 180 (-35, ledger 'No hint used 1 hint used 0' + 'Hint used -15'); Master 'Clinical Detective' with 1 hint + 1 wrong = 455 of 570, i.e. the single hint cost 75 XP, five times the stated 15 (see B39-003-master-result.png). /api/rules lists noHint and hintPenalty separately but no screen states the combined cost before the learner decides; the dashboard only says 'a hint costs more'. The learner learns the real price only on the result ledger.
findings.fix_hint: Say 'The first hint on a mission also forfeits the No-hint bonus (N XP)' next to the button using /api/rules values, and count the forfeited bonus in XP penalty so far.

findings.evidence: Prod bundle loaded at http://localhost:5902 while built for http://127.0.0.1:3902/api (CORS_ORIGIN exactly http://127.0.0.1:5902); same on dev 5901. User sees 'Demo laboratory unavailable ... Cannot reach the Escape Lab server. Check your connection and retry.' with Reopen button; the real cause (CORS: origin not allowed) is only in the console. Retrying can never succeed, nothing says to open the site on the address the server was configured for. The demo script mentions the 127.0.0.1 vs localhost trap, the UI does not.
findings.fix_hint: On a status-0 failure at startup add a line such as 'If you opened this page on a different address than the one the server expects (localhost vs 127.0.0.1), use the address from the instructions.'

findings.evidence: Student who cleared everything (all 100%): Lab results, Master Lab card lists four competencies all at 100% and prints 'Strongest area: Hematology interpretation.' (first of a four-way tie). The same on the standard labs (e.g. Microbiology 'Strongest area' with one competency). A strongest-area claim is made when nothing is stronger than anything else.
findings.fix_hint: Print 'Strongest area' only when one competency strictly leads; otherwise omit or say all at 100%.

findings.evidence: Two tabs on hem-02 (same shared guest, same attempt id eae27ed7...). Tab A answers step 1; tab B (stale, still on step 1) submits step 1: B shows only 'This could not be completed. This is not the current step.' while its screen silently jumps to step 2; no mention that the attempt was advanced elsewhere. Concurrent hint presses: server charged one hint (-15, correct, no double charge); tab B shows Hint 1 text plus an alert 'No more hints are available for this step.' with no explanation that the other tab already bought it. After A finishes, B's next submit lands on the result screen with no explanation. No lost hint, no double charge, no corrupted state.
findings.fix_hint: Map wrong_step / no_more_hints on a resync to 'This case was changed in another tab or window; the screen now shows the current step.'
